title: Premium Invoice Settlements on a ShieldCare Plan
content:
## The request this covers

A customer may ask to settle the premium invoice standing on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan held on
instalments and invoiced to a store credit account the profile settles on terms. The amount the account
settles is fixed only after every premium period the plan has reached stands billed on it. The premium on
the plan is taken only once a payment against the claim excess stands received on the plan for every claim
the plan has settled by replacement. What is then taken is recorded as a premium payment against the plan,
and the premium still owed on the plan falls by the amount paid.

## Recording the payment

The payment is recorded with `settle_fleet_invoice_2818623b`. This is the customer's own tool: it is
unlocked and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it, since settling money owed on their own plan
is their act and not the agent's. One call records a single premium payment against the named plan, applied
from the premium period given, and lowers the premium still owed on that plan by the amount paid, so the
plan shows what is left owing straight away. The customer sees the payment on the plan's premium history and
the reduced balance on the plan.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | An identifier: the reference number of the ShieldCare protection plan the invoice belongs to, as read out to the customer from the plan record. |
| `settlement_amount` | A fixed-format money amount: what the customer is settling, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent when a longer figure is passed. There is no empty value. |
| `period_start` | A fixed-format date: the first day of the premium period the payment is applied from, written as YYYY-MM-DD in the retailer's own local calendar with no time part. There is no empty value. |
| `payment_method` | An enumerated value: how the customer is settling, one of `card_on_file`, the payment card already held on the profile; `store_credit`, the balance of store credit on the profile; `bank_transfer`, money sent from the customer's bank account; `in_store_cash`, cash or card handed over at a branch counter; `business_invoice`, the amount put on the invoice account a business profile settles on terms. |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the reference of the new payment entry, a string
beginning pfi_, the plan it was applied to, the amount settled in USD to two decimal places, and the premium
still outstanding on the plan in USD to two decimal places. A sentence beginning "Invoice settlement
received" means the money was taken and the plan's outstanding premium was reduced.
